build_capability_evidence.cause: No Android SDK present, same as run 1. ANDROID_HOME and ANDROID_SDK_ROOT are unset; /opt holds gradle, maven, node, ruby, rbenv, rclone and pw-browsers but no android-sdk; no SDK at ~/Android/Sdk or /usr/lib/android-sdk; no local.properties. Gradle 8.14.3 and JDK 21.0.10 are present, so the blocker is the SDK alone.
notes: Run 1 established the same result by actually invoking the task and recording the SDK-location failure. Run 2 re-probed the environment for an SDK rather than repeating a multi-minute Gradle configuration that can only fail the same way.
Submodules taglib and ffMetadataEx were absent on checkout again and were self-healed with 'git submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1' (exit 0, taglib/build.gradle.kts present afterwards).

Consequence: every patch produced in this environment is UNVERIFIED, and the Verifiability dimension cannot score above 6/25 for anything that is not pure JVM logic. :app still has no JVM unit-test source set; only :innertube and :kugou do (innertube/build.gradle.kts:18 is the sole junit dependency).

Practical effect on the 80/100 patch bar: with Verifiability capped at 6, a finding must score a perfect 25/25/25 on the other three dimensions to reach 81. Nothing did this run, so no code PR was opened.
